subject.title: Dashboard: editable notes / todo / markdown widget (stateful)

question: Should a persistent notes/todo/markdown widget be bundled into OpenClaw's dashboard after write-back lands, or should it live as an external ClawHub/plugin widget?
rationale: The request is a new user-facing dashboard capability that depends on unlanded widget state and on maintainer choices about bundled dashboard scope, storage, and distribution.

options.title: Bundle After Write-Back
options.body: Keep this issue open and implement the widget only after the write-back and dashboard workspace contracts are accepted and landed.

options.title: Move To ClawHub
options.body: Treat the widget as an optional plugin or custom-widget package once the public widget APIs are sufficient.

options.title: Defer Dashboard Widgets
options.body: Pause this and related built-ins until maintainers explicitly sponsor the broader dashboard roadmap.

recommendation.title: Bundle After Write-Back
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and implement the widget only after the write-back and dashboard workspace contracts are accepted and landed.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-main owner signal for the plugin-tab/Control UI precedent and the likely routing point for bundled dashboard scope.
